holes.notes: Page hole 1 is most likely card hole 18. OSM tee boxes on this hole sit at 434/406/383/366 yds, which fit card hole 18 (White 429, Red 405, Gold 389) and not hole 1 (348/334/300/263); its green is beside the clubhouse (4141 SE East Edge Rd) and the next tee, so this is the finishing hole. Blue 455 is ~20 yds behind the back OSM box (extrapolated on the hole line). Tee fix points are on the hole line at the card length from the OSM green centre (approximate).

Page hole 2 is most likely card hole 1. Tee is next to the clubhouse and car park (page picture). OSM tee boxes at 341/308/260 fit card hole 1 (348/334?/300/263). The page's Blue tee is a lidar pad at 369 yds, 16 yds off any OSM box: with the right number it should sit on the back OSM box (~348). Tee fix points are on the hole line at the card length from the OSM green centre (approximate).

Page hole 3 is most likely card hole 2. Follows on from the clubhouse-side hole. OSM boxes at 366/385; card hole 2 Blue 369 fits the 366 box (the page puts Blue on a lidar pad at 352, 6 yds from it). White 330 is a walkback on the page (320). Tee fix points are on the hole line at the card length from the OSM green centre (approximate).

Page hole 4 is most likely card hole 3. OSM tags this hole par 4 (provenance: 'card (OSM says 4)'), hole line 339 yds, tee boxes at 365/338/306/277: it is a ~350-yd par 4, not the 148-yd par-3 hole 4. The page walked the tee 125 yds up the fairway to fake a 148-yd par 3: the page hole is unplayable as drawn. Next in the chain after hole 2, so card hole 3 (par 4, 353/320). Tee fix points are on the hole line at the card length from the OSM green centre (approximate).
Not on the page: OSM maps only 4 holes (4 greens, 13 tees, 5 fairways) on this 18-hole course; the structure/v2 routers could not place the rest.

course_notes: Only 4 of 18 holes exist on the page (OSM maps 4); not publishable.
The 4 built holes are numbered 1-4 by structure inference, but the evidence (OSM tee-box distances, OSM par 4 on page hole 4, clubhouse beside page hole 2's tee) says they are card holes 18, 1, 2, 3.
Page hole 4 is a par-4 corridor shown as a 148-yd par 3 with the tee walked 125 yds up the fairway.
No osm_supplement written: the fix needs the 14 unmapped holes traced from imagery (or mapped in OSM); renumbering 4 holes alone would not make the page usable.
